explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/594: does every graph with chromatic number ≥ ℵ₁ contain all sufficiently large odd cycles? Proved by Erdős–Hajnal–Shelah [EHS74]. The Lean statement: for every V : Type and G with no proper ℕ-colouring (equivalently, chromatic number ≥ ℵ₁, i.e. uncountable), there is N such that for all k ≥ N, G has a cycle (Walk.IsCycle) of length 2k+1. Restricting to Type (universe 0) is harmless. Positive 'yes' form per the question convention. Faithful.
